programme.desc: Strings! Brass! Woodwinds! Percussion! After Gil and Molly meet a conductor, the Guppies want to join an orchestra. Led by a conductor from another planet, the Guppies’ orchestra will make music that’s out of this world!

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: Oh no! Nonny broke his glasses! When they’re fixed, Nonny is determined to retrieve them on his own. But to do it, he’ll have to depend on his other four senses to reach the glasses store before it closes!

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: When rain spoils a game of kickball, Gil invents a new game that shows how fun a little rain can be. But when the weather turns too wet, even for puddleball, Bubble Puppy must overcome his fear of thunder to save the game!

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: Bzzzz! The Guppies are busy living the bees’ life! Turning nectar into honey is tough bzzness. It takes a lot of teamwork every step of the way. Can the kids work together to make honey for the queen bee’s teatime?

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: Ribbit! Gil and Goby bring a tadpole named Fernando to school to watch him grow into a frog. When Fernando’s ready to hop, Gil and Goby will have to lead him back to his pond in the traditional Running of the Bullfrogs!

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: It seems like everyone in Bubbletucky is coming down with a cold-even Mr. Grouper! No need to worry; in their very own "soap opera," the Guppies will use their good hygiene to show Mr. Grouper how to get better!

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: When Mr. Grouper’s van gets stuck in the holiday snow, Mr. Claws and his horse Snowflake come to the rescue! With snow falling and bells jingling, the Guppies will experience their first sleigh ride!

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The Guppies love fruits and vegetables, but Deema doesn’t want to try broccoli! When the Guppies face their scout troop initiation, Deema will have to turn over a new leaf if she wants to earn her broccoli badge.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: Molly and Gil find a lost kitten named Bubble Kitty, and the Guppies learn that house cats are related to big cats. When Bubble Kitty's owner calls, the kids take Bubble Kitty home to Meownt Rushmore, a rocky tribute to cats!

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: Fall is here! Molly and Gil can’t wait to pick pumpkins, but when they lead everyone to the pumpkin patch, the pumpkins are gone! Their turkey friend Giblet leads them on a hunt to find the culprits: the pumpkin patch pirates!

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: Molly and Oona run into the Mayor training for Bubbletucky’s annual marathon! But when she gets a tummyache, she’ll go to the hospital to get checked out.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: Molly and Gil meet Buddy, a baby dolphin with the friendliest face in the sea! Today is Buddy’s first birthday, and his pod is throwing him a surprise birthday party! Can the Guppies lead Buddy to the party?
programme.sub-title: A Dolphin is a Guppy's Best Friend!

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: When Leah wishes for help making cupcakes for a bake sale, she and the genies find themselves stuck with a giant birthday cake, some farm animals, and a river of cupcake batter. How will Leah finish without any wishes left?

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: After searching endlessly for Zac's missing dinosaur toy, Leah asks her genies to wish up a replacement and gets stuck with a real live Apatosaurus! Leah, Shimmer, and Shine have to figure out a way to fix this behemoth mistake.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: Leah and Zac try building a treehouse but find themselves in over their heads. Leah asks her genies for a treehouse and is thrown for a loop when Shimmer and Shine turn her house into a house of trees!

programme.title: South Park: Suivez cet œuf
programme.desc: Madame Garrison a encore des sentiments pour Monsieur Esclave, mais en allant le voir elle s'aperçoit qu'il est avec Al Super Gay et qu'ils comptent se marier.

programme.title: South Park: Les Rouquins
programme.desc: Cartman fait un exposé raciste sur les roux. Pour lui donner une leçon, Stan, Kyle et Kenny le teignent en roux dans son sommeil. Mais Cartman s'adapte à la situation en créant une ligue qui clame la supériorité des roux.

programme.title: South Park: Piégé dans le placard
programme.desc: Stan est endoctriné par l'Église de Scientologie avant de découvrir qu'il ne s'agit que d'une vaste machination.

programme.title: South Park: Sauvez Wilzy-X
programme.desc: Les enfants mettent tout en œuvre pour sauver Wilzy-X, une orque du bassin, et pour tenter de réaliser son rêve d'aller sur la lune. Ils ne réalisent pas qu'ils sont victimes d'un canular.

programme.title: South Park: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: Le père de Stan est alcoolique. Le petit garçon tente d'aider son père, d'autant que celui-ci est très mal conseillé par les Alcooliques Anonymes.

programme.title: South Park: Le Retour de Chef
programme.desc: Chef est de retour à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Danger Snobfog
programme.desc: Les habitants de South Park achètent des voitures hybrides. Toutefois, alors que les habitants commencent à se sentir mieux parce qu'ils sauvent la planète, une masse noire orageuse recouvre la ville.

programme.title: South Park: Un million de petites fibres
programme.desc: Towelie écrit un livre qui est sélectionné par le club de lecture d'Oprah. Il devient un best-seller et se destine aux gens cherchant à dépasser leurs dépendances.

programme.title: South Park: Homoursporc
programme.desc: Les enfants essaient d'aider l'ancien vice-président Al Gore à se faire entendre par la population mais ils se retrouvent coincés dans une grotte. Alors qu'ils essaient d'en sortir, Cartman découvre un trésor.

programme.title: South Park: Tsst!
programme.desc: La mère d'Éric n'a aucun contrôle sur son fils. Elle fait alors appel à plusieurs Nounou mais chacune échoue à leur mission. Un dresseur de chien prend alors la relève pour dompter Éric.

programme.title: South Park: Make Love, Not Warcraft
programme.desc: Les garçons jouent à World of Warcraft pendant tout le week-end lorsqu'un méchant joueur les tue sans aucun remord.

programme.title: South Park: Le Mystère du caca dans l'urinoir
programme.desc: Cartman croit savoir qui est à l'origine des attaques du 11 septembre.
programme.sub-title: Le Mystère du caca dans l'urinoir

programme.title: South Park: La Maitresse de Ike
programme.desc: C'est au tour de Cartman d'être le surveillant des couloirs, il profite de l'autorité qui lui est confié pour faire régner l'ordre sévèrement. Pendant ce temps, Ike tombe amoureux de sa maîtresse et ils ont une relation ensemble.

programme.title: South Park: L'Enfer sur Terre
programme.desc: Satan organise une énorme fête pour petite gamine pourrie gâtée pendant que les enfants de South Park tentent d'invoquer le rappeur Biggie Small en prononçant trois fois son nom devant un miroir.

programme.title: South Park: Vas-y Dieu, Vas-y Dieu (1/2)
programme.desc: Éric ne supporte plus d'attendre la sortie de la Nintendo Wii et ne veut pas endurer trois semaines de patience supplémentaire. Il décide alors de se congeler pour se réveiller le jour de la sortie de la Wii.

programme.title: South Park: Vas-y Dieu, Vas-y Dieu (2/2)
programme.desc: Toujours 500 ans dans le futur, Cartman est mêlé à la guerre mais ils est plus préoccupé à trouver un moyen de jouer à la Wii. Cela étant impossible dans le futur, il cherche une façon de retourner à son époque.

programme.title: South Park: La Coupe Stanley
programme.desc: Stan entraîne l'équipe poussins de hockey et essaie d'en faire des gagnants.

programme.title: South Park: Avec nos excuses à Jesse Jackson
programme.desc: Randy Marsh dit le mot « nègre » à la télévision nationale et devient la risée du pays ; Cartman se moque d'un nain et se bat contre lui.
programme.sub-title: Avec nos excuses à Jesse Jackson

programme.title: South Park: La Photo
programme.desc: Cartman veut faire croire que Butters est gay, mais lorsque le père de ce dernier s'en aperçoit, il envoie Butters dans un camp de rééducation.

programme.title: South Park: Les Poux
programme.desc: Une infection de poux atteint l'école primaire de South Park. Alors que Madame Garrison refuse de donner des noms, Cartman trouve un moyen de savoir qui a des poux et ainsi de se moquer des enfants atteints.

programme.title: South Park: Chattomique
programme.desc: Un nouvel élève arrive a South Park : un jeune arabe. Cartman pense alors qu'un attentat se prépare. Grâce à Kyle, branché sur Internet, ils remontent la piste d'un attentat imminent sur Hillary Clinton en visite à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Le Fantastique Mystère de Pâques
programme.desc: Stan se demande pourquoi on doit peindre des œufs le jour de Pâques. Il ne s'attendait pas à découvrir un secret aussi énorme.

programme.title: South Park: G-Win!
programme.desc: Madame Garrison se fait plaquer pour la dernière fois. Elle compte bien passer toute sa colère sur sa classe de CM1.

programme.title: South Park: La Nuit des clochards-vivants
programme.desc: La ville doit faire face à une recrudescence des SDF. Les enfants vont essayer de régler ce problème épineux.

programme.title: South Park: Le Petite Tourette
programme.desc: Cartman prétend avoir le syndrome Gilles de la Tourette pour pouvoir dire des choses affreuses en direct à la télévision.

programme.title: South Park: Gros Caca
programme.desc: Randy est constipé. Il prend alors des laxatifs pour aller déféquer. Après quelques instants de terribles douleurs sur le trône, Randy s'apprête à tirer la chasse mais il remarque que son caca est démesurément grand.

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland Episode 1
programme.desc: Eric assure avoir aperçu un leprechaun dans la forêt, mais Kyle ne le croit pas. Ils font un pari ensemble : si Cartman prouve l'existence du leprechaun, Kyle devra lui sucer les boules sinon il devra donner 10$ à Kyle.

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland Episode 2
programme.desc: Les pires créatures ont été libérées par les terroristes et dévastent Imaginationland, où Butters est toujours piégé. Le gouvernement réquisitionne Stan et Kyle afin de trouver un moyen d'entrer à Imaginationland.

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland Episode 3
programme.desc: Suite à l'accident du portail, Stan est entré dans Imaginationland où Butters est considéré par les créatures imaginaires comme un élu capable de sauver Imaginationland.

programme.title: South Park: Guitar Zéro
programme.desc: Stan et Kyle sont accros au jeu Guitar Hero. Mais Stan est meilleur que Kyle, et leur amitié semble s'en dégrader.

programme.title: South Park: La Liste
programme.desc: Les filles ont une liste des garçons les plus beaux de la classe. Clyde est premier, mais à sa grande déception Kyle est dernier.

programme.title: South Park: Amygdales
programme.desc: Cartman se retrouve à devoir lutter pour sa vie lorsqu'une banale opération des amygdales tourne mal.

programme.title: South Park: Le Nouveau Look de Britney
programme.desc: Alors que les garçons aident Britney Spears à atteindre le pôle Nord, ils découvrent le secret qui se cache derrière sa popularité.

programme.title: South Park: Planète Gros Nibards
programme.desc: Dans cet hommage de South Park au film de 1981 « Métal Hurlant », les garçons découvrent que ce qui défonce réellement, c'est le pipi de chat.

programme.title: South Park: Canada en grève
programme.desc: Lassé d'être ridiculisé, le Canada se met en grève pour avoir plus d'argent et du respect. Cependant, personne ne prend cette grève au sérieux, excepté les enfants.

programme.title: South Park: Ciel, une quéquette !
programme.desc: Madame Garrison tente de trouver un moyen de redevenir l'homme qu'elle aurait toujours dû être. Cartman doit alors la remplacer et s'occuper de la classe.

programme.title: South Park: Y'a plus d'Internet
programme.desc: Les habitants de South Park se réveillent et découvrent qu'ils n'ont plus Internet.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Luffy’s epic battle with Eneru, sunny skies chase away the storms, and the cloud-dwelling citizens of Angel Island turn their attention to rebuilding their homeland.
programme.sub-title: The battle ends! Proud fantasia echoes far!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Robin attempts to decipher the riddle of a mysterious poneglyph, Usopp barters with the locals, and Luffy raids the priceless treasures of the legendary city of gold!
programme.sub-title: I made it here! The yarn the poneglyphs spin!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With a little help from their new friends – and a giant octopus – the Straw Hats bid farewell to Skypiea and begin their descent back to the deep blue sea. Where they’ll land is anyone’s guess!
programme.sub-title: Off to the blue sea! A heartfelt finale!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: After a frightening fall from the clouds, the Straw Hats find themselves trapped inside an impenetrable Marine stronghold. The crew gets separated, the Going Merry is impounded, and rumors of ghosts run rampant!
programme.sub-title: A state of emergency is issued! A notorious pirate ship has infiltrated!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While Nami searches for the Going Merry, Luffy and Sanji pose as famous chefs, only to end up competing in a cooking contest with a beautiful mistress of the galley!
programme.sub-title: Sanji the cook! Proving his merit at the marine dining hall!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro is imprisoned and interrogated, and Chopper’s ill-chosen hiding spot lands him in the operating room along with a doctor who can’t stand the sight of blood!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy’s insatiable appetite betrays his true identity, and yet another member of his crew ends up in the brig when two Straw Hats try to fool Commander Jonathan with the same disguise!
programme.sub-title: The marine's dragnet closes in! The second member captured!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Commander Jonathan sets a Straw Hat trap, but Luffy and Sanji are willing to risk it all to help spring their mates. Will a souvenir from the sky save the day – or will their escape plan be scuttled by foul play?
programme.sub-title: Luffy and sanji's daring rescue mission!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his gang make a break for the docks, and Commander Jonathan deploys armed guards in an attempt to slow down the Straw Hats. Only one thing is certain: somebody is going down for the count!
programme.sub-title: Enter the hot-blooded special forces! Battle on the bridge!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats are surrounded, outnumbered, blasted with tear gas. Taking a pretty, young doctor hostage may be their only hope for surviving long enough for a Merry reunion!
programme.sub-title: Breaking through the seige! The going merry is recovered!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his crew were almost in the clear when Nami made a horrifying discovery: the Marines stole their gold! Now, the Straw Hats must sail straight into the thick of the fight to reclaim their lost riches!
programme.sub-title: The pirate ship disappears! Fortress battle, round #2!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Usopp hatches a plan for a moonlit raid on the Marine vault, but Commander Jonathan is has a nasty surprise waiting for the pirates! Meanwhile, Sanji and Nami attempt to recover the waver.
programme.sub-title: The gold and waver recovery operations!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The extreme arrogance of a Marine special investigator clears a path for Luffy and company to make their escape! Unfortunately, the Straw Hats still have to find their gold before returning to the high seas!
programme.sub-title: The one fell swoop plan! Jonathan's surefire secret tactic!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats may think they’re in the clear, but Commander Jonathan has one final trap waiting to ground the Going Merry! If Luffy’s crew is to escape, they’ll need a helping hand – or eight!
programme.sub-title: Farewell, marine fortress! The last battle for escape!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his mates survive and near-death encounter with some mischievous sea monkeys only to land on a mysterious island where everything is much longer than it should be!
programme.sub-title: Great adventure at long ring long land!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: After a loyal horse and his recently-returned master are assaulted by thugs, Luffy is drawn into a Davy Back Fight with the Foxy Pirates. The Straw Hat captain never backs down from a challenge, but this contest could cost him his crew!
programme.sub-title: A davy back with the foxy pirates!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Davy Back Fight begins with a treacherous Donut Race around Ling Ring Long Land! The Straw Hats square off against the Foxy Pirates in a battle to see who loses a crew member!
programme.sub-title: Round 1! One lap of the donut race!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami uses her considerable skill as a navigator to put the Straw Hats on the verge of victory, but the captain of the Foxy Pirates has more than a few dirty tricks up his sleeve!
programme.sub-title: Silver fox foxy! The merciless interference!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Thanks to some foxy sabotage, Chopper has been lost to the enemy. The only hope for getting him back lies with Zoro and Sanji, but can they learn to work together in time to save the little reindeer?
programme.sub-title: Round 2! Shoot it into the groggy ring!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sanji and Zoro take a beating at the hands of the Groggy Monsters, but they won’t give up the fight. With a little luck – and some teamwork – they’ll emerge victorious from round two of the Davy Back Fight!
programme.sub-title: A barrage of red cards in groggy ring!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Round three of the Davy Back Fight is a rip roaring roller derby! Chopper’s fate still hangs in the balance, and the Straw Hats have a huge problem: Luffy doesn’t know how to skate!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: As the Davy Back Fight sprints toward a sensational finish, the Straw Hats find themselves on the brink of defeat! Luffy’s finally managed to stay on his skates, but the Foxy Pirates are notorious cheaters!
programme.sub-title: A seriously heated race! Into the final round!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats somehow manage to defeat the Foxy Pirates and win back Chopper, but Luffy eagerly accepts the challenge of a rematch! What is the captain thinking? And will his crew mutiny?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A devious game of dodge ball costs the Straw Hats their archaeologist. Now, they’ll have to win an unusual uphill race to reclaim Robin and avoid losing another crew member!
programme.sub-title: Showdown on the cliff! Red light, green light!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Robin and Chopper have both been lost to the Foxy Pirates, and there’s only one match remaining in the Davy Back Fight! Luffy’s got a plan to get his mates back, but failure would mean the end of the Straw Hats forever!
programme.sub-title: The captains square off! The final combat round!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Captain Foxy go toe-to-toe in a brutal battle waged aboard a booby-trapped boat. Luffy is fighting for his crew, but Captain Foxy’s dirty tricks have him on the ropes!
programme.sub-title: Full-blast slow-slow onslaught vs. Invulnerable luffy

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy’s epic battle with Captain Foxy reaches its riveting end, and a very old man with a very tall horse reunites with a face from very long ago.
programme.sub-title: Epic, heated combat! The fateful final conclusion

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: When Luffy and his mates lose their memory, Robin is the only Straw Hat who can remember their adventures together. Can she recover their recollections before the crew splits up?
programme.sub-title: Was it lost? Stolen? Who are you?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Robin tries to hold the crew together while unraveling the mystery of the missing memories. Meanwhile, Nami and Zoro flashback to painful moments from their pasts.
programme.sub-title: A mysterious boy with a horn and robin's deduction!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats finally discover the culprit behind their memory loss, but they’ve got bigger problems. The mysterious thief is determined to pit Zoro and Luffy against each other!
programme.sub-title: Now, let's get back our memories! The pirate crew lands on the island!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro and Luffy fight to the death, Nami attempts to orchestrate an uprising, and Sanji discovers he’s willing to kick a kid in order to get his memories back!
programme.sub-title: Zoro bares his fangs! A savage animal stands in the way!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats finally regain their memories, but a much larger challenge looms on the horizon. The mysterious thief is about to transform into something even more powerful!
programme.sub-title: The last counterattack by the memory thief who reveals his true colors!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A terrible storm leads to another run in with the devious Captain Foxy! When Luffy makes the dangerous decision to help his old foe, it could spell disaster for the Straw Hats!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his mates must survive another outrageous battle aboard Captain Foxy’s booby-trapped boat, and even if they survive, something far worse awaits them!
programme.sub-title: The guy who's the closest to invincible? And the most dangerous man!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: El Coqui: In this version of the famous Puerto Rican legend, Dora and Boots find a sad, homesick little coqui who's lost his voice. Dora and Boots offer to take the frog home to his island.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Stuck Truck: Calling all trucks! Boots sure loves trucks. When Ice Cream Truck gets stuck in the muck at Play Park, Dora and Boots are off to the rescue. Boots uses his truck phone to call his other truck friends for help along the way.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Louder!: What are we going to do? Cockledoodledoo! Dora and Boots help their friend, Red Rooster, get to the Highest Hill so he can wake up the Sun. Along the way we practice making lots of noise.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Roberto The Robot: Dora and Boots meet Roberto, a very cool robot with a tool belt, flashing lights, stretching powers and super strength. But Roberto's lost!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Big Potato: Benny the Bull finds a magic wand and turns himself into a potato by mistake. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring their potato friend back to the Young Wizard so that he can change Benny back into a bull again.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Journey To The Purple Planet: Blast into outer space as Dora and Boots set off to bring stranded space creatures back home to the Purple Planet. Take a wild ride on a rocketship, travel through the Milky Way, and catch a ride on a comet.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Lost City: Where do toys go when they're lost? To the Lost City! But the Lost City is really hard to find. Dora and Boots are on an educational, Indiana Jones-like adventure as they race through the Number Pyramid and the Jumbled Jungle.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Meet Diego!: Meet Diego, Dora's super cool cousin. Diego works at the Animal Rescue Center. He can make animal noises and talk to wild animals!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Save The Puppies: Woof! Woof! Dora and Boots have a new video game called "Save the Puppies." A mean dogcatcher has locked up all the puppies in the Doggie Cages. To save them, Dora and Boots super jump into the video game.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: ¡Por Favor!: Dora and Boots read a fairy tale about a young kinkajou - a cute and cuddly forest creature - who is destined to be king. But the kinkajou loses his crown because he doesn't know the magic words, "por favor."

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Baby Dino: Dora, Boots and Diego need to bring a giant baby dinosaur home to his mommy at Dino Island. It's a prehistoric adventure through a land of dinosaurs. Tiptoe past a T-Rex, meet a Compsagnathus - the world's smallest dinosaur.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boots' Special Day: Today, Boots gets to do anything he wants, because it's his special day! Un día especial. Boots most favorite thing in the whole world is to visit his daddy at work.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: To The South Pole: Rescue Truck arrives at Diego's Animal Center to deliver a cute, little animal that's really lost: a penguin! It's up to Dora, Boots and Diego to bring Pingüino all the way back home to the South Pole.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves The Game: Dora's cousin Daisy is playing in a big soccer game that's showing on TV. But Daisy's team is short a player. Daisy appeals to Dora to come play on her team and save the game. Run, Dora, run!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: What Happens Next?: What comes after "The End"? Dora and Boots are finishing a fairy tale, and reach the end of the story. They wonder what happens next.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Rescue, Rescue, Rescue: Oh no! Three of our friends are in trouble. Baby Jaguar is stuck in a tree, Isa is stuck in a big sand hole, and Benny is stuck in his balloon on top of the Gooey Geyser. Who do we have to rescue first?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boot's Cuddly Dinosaur: It's bedtime, and Dora and Boots are having a sleepover. Dora has her teddy bear, Osito, but Boots can't find his cuddly dinosaur. Oh no! His dinosaur must have fallen out of his bag at Play Park.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Super Silly Fiesta: Bawk! It's fiesta time! Dora and Boots are invited to the Big Red Chicken's Super Silly Fiesta! There will be silly snacks, silly games, silly hats and even silly dancing.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Fix-It Machine: Uh oh! Boots has a hole - un hoyo - in his boot! But Dora knows what to do. They can go to the Super Duper Fix-It Machine to fix it right up!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Baseball Boots: Boots loves baseball. He loves to run and catch and throw, but so far he's never gotten a hit. Boots is determined to get his first hit. Dora and Boots have a big baseball game today.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Happy Best Friends Day! Today's a special day for best friends to play together. Boots and Dora decide to meet for a picnic to celebrate. Boots is bringing chocolate; Dora is bringing yummy strawberries.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: A is for armadillo, but where are the rest of the animals in the ABC book? They're missing! Dora and Boots jump into the giant alphabet book to help the little armadillo solve the mystery.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tracey says her 23-year marriage is falling apart because husband Doug is having an affair with transgender female Essence. Tracey wants Doug to choose once and for all so that she can move on with her life. Why is she leaving the decision to him?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Jenaye posted an emotional video online about uncovering her husband James's infidelity she never imagined it would go viral. Discovering James slept with his hairstylist on their fifth anniversary, Jenaye says divorce might be the best option.
programme.sub-title: My Husband's Cheating Went Viral Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Heather's son, Brandon, 15, died of an accidental overdose at her home; authorities say the teen swallowed & snorted Heather's morphine pills while drinking vodka and beer. Acquitted of charges, Heather says her ex-husband Brian continues to blame her.
programme.sub-title: Acquitted By A Jury But My Ex-Husband Still Thinks I'm Guilty Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with Melissa and her mother, Michelle, who say time is running out for 14-year-old Destoni. Melissa says her daughter’s outrageous behavior will land her in jail, or even worse, get her killed. Part 2
programme.sub-title: Destoni's Drama: Will She Accept Help Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Angie says stepfather Ralph routinely sexually abused her as a teen. Angie says that her stepfather didn't stop with her, he turned his attention, affection & sexual abuse toward her daughter Hannah. They say grandma Leta knew, yet looked the other way.
programme.sub-title: Did Step-Dad Molest His Step-Daughter And Granddaughter? What Did Grandma Know? Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Harv and Lynne say their son, Mark, is an adolescent living in a 41-year-old man’s body. Mark is currently homeless and living in his beat-up car held together with bungee cords and glue. But Mark explains that he is “car camping” and not homeless.
programme.sub-title: Our Son Is A 40-Year-Old Homeless Car Camper

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sandra and ex-husband Joey admit they’re in a bitter custody battle. Sandra and Joey’s mudslinging has frightening accusations, but are they telling the truth? See what happens when these parents are offered polygraph and drug tests. Part 2
programme.sub-title: A Bitter Custody Battle: Claims Of Poison In Ice Cream, A Child Wrapped In A Garbage Bag And Inappropriate Touching: What Will The Polygraph Reveal Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Kristi said it was love at first sight when she met Michael. They married, had three kids, but when the union went awry nine years later, they divorced, and are now in an all-out war affecting the most vulnerable members of the family — the children.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Gina says her daughter, Alexis, 18, was "kidnapped" and "held hostage" by her survivalist boyfriend, David, 19, which Alexis and David deny. Mom Gina fears for Alexis's safety. David agrees he’s a survivalist who owns guns, but he's not dangerous. Part 1
programme.sub-title: I'm Afraid My Daughter Was Kidnapped By Her Survivalist Boyfriend Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ashley was sexually abused by her father from ages of 5 to 18, locked in a small camper, while giving birth to four of her father's children. In her first national interview since her father's arrest, the 22-year-old mom speaks about her horrible ordeal.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Keirsten claims her boyfriend, Mike, has slammed her face into the car radio and repeatedly hit her in the head, giving her several black eyes and a bloody lip. Although Mike's been arrested twice for domestic battery, she loves him and he's a great dad.
programme.sub-title: Daughter's Boyfriend Has Been Arrested For Domestic Battery Twice But She Refuses To Leave Him

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jodie says since husband Edwin won $1.66 million in a lottery pool, he's angry, distant, secretive & the marriage is in trouble. Edwin says problems started way before his money win. The couple talks to Dr. Phil wondering if their marriage can be saved.
programme.sub-title: My Husband's Big Lottery Win Is Ruining Our Marriage

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Monica's old life: English teacher, marathon runner, happy. Now 90 lbs. and no solid food with a C-diff diagnosis, she chains herself to bed to avoid sleepwalking or binge eating. It's a full-time job for mom, Stephanie; friend Breanna suspects enabling.
programme.sub-title: Painfully Ill: Can Monica Be Saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tensions run high in this father/daughter battle conclusion. McKinley, 18, confronts her dad for allegedly being "abusive" in her childhood & a "pedophile," claims he denies. Dr. Phil questions Cory on an incident leading to Cory's sexual battery arrest.
programme.sub-title: An Abusive Father Or A Delusional Teen: Who Is Telling The Truth? Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Michelle thought she had a perfect marriage until Wade admitted to keeping a horrible secret from his wife. Little did she know this one revelation would be the tip of the iceberg. Dr. Phil continues the startling story of Wade and Michelle. Part 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tina says her sons lived in a “house of horrors” with their biological father, Jeff, and his wife, Sandra, with reports to Child Protective Services that “fell on deaf ears.” Son Ian and Christa, also from the home, tell of horrific abuse they endured.
programme.sub-title: Adopted Twin, Beaten, Strangled, Starved And Locked In A Room: The Exclusive Interview

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Brittany claims dad Charlie is scammed by his online fiancée "Stephanie" & her roommate "Carina." Charlie has given over $25K while "Stephanie" maintains a $4.5 million inheritance is coming. The investigation starts in Los Angeles and ends in Denmark!
programme.sub-title: Love Or Larceny: My Father's Fiance Is Fake Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Trust has been ranked as the #1 crucial quality for a happy marriage. Deanne & Brian have been married for 12 years with four children between them. Now, due to alleged lies and infidelity, their family is torn apart and divorce is just a signature away.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his work with a family ripped apart by accusations of child molestation. Father Jason agrees to take a polygraph test to prove his innocence. Tune in to find out the results and what's next for this family!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tammy and Paul wed for eight years until their marriage ended. After nine months apart the couple secretly remarried, unbeknownst to their families, who would not approve. Weeks after saying "I do" a second time, the two are having doubts of their own.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.sub-title: Test Results Revealed: Is 15-Year-Old Marie Really Pregnant Pt. 2
